drhp.business: Nureca operates in the Indian home-healthcare space, addressing demand for preventive healthcare, home diagnostics and wellness solutions. The Company reaches consumers through digital and quick commerce platforms alongside an expanding digital ecosystem, and describes its manufacturing capabilities as strengthened during the year. Its broader mission, as stated in the governance report, is to alleviate human suffering by delivering globally competitive, high-quality and affordable healthcare solutions.

drhp.expansion: Nureca's principal expansion project is an upcoming manufacturing facility at Sundran, Punjab, described by the Chairman as one of the most important investments in the Company's history. It is being developed as a modern healthcare manufacturing platform spanning medical devices, consumables, hygiene products and allied categories, and is framed not merely as production capacity but as an integrated capability set covering product engineering, process control, automation, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, vendor development and continuous improvement. sk.overview: The DRHP frames the issuer within India's broader healthcare industry and, more specifically, the Indian medical device sector.
